answer: Anchor every identity to a circadian rhythm. Registration starts at the nadir of trust: zero weight, $40 bond locked. Each epoch the protocol fires a beacon challenge at a random hour, answered within ten minutes, matching its timezone and sleep-wake history. One operator cannot staff N puppets: each needs its human on shift, about $18 wages per challenge, and two missed beacons slash the $40 bond and reset the identity to the nadir. History accrues one epoch at a time and cannot be bought or parallel-grown, so the tenth puppet costs as much as the first, like a tundra outpost one person mans.
